description: Read HoneyBook client-portal data (contracts, invoices, proposals, payment methods, workspace status) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the honeybook-mcp server — capture a vendor session once via the signed-in browser tab, then curl api.honeybook.com directly. Use when you want HoneyBook data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
